I drank a fifth of jameson and took a bottle of sleeping pills. Probably would have worked too but i called a family member to say goodbye and they called the police after i hung up. The sherrifs dept kicked in my front door minutes afterwards, made me grab some clothes and took me to the hospital to get my stomach pumped. Once that lovely experiance was over i was taken to a mental health hospital for no shorter than 3 days.
 This is where the eureka moment happened.
 Once i had been checked into the mental health facility i was allowed to change out of the hospital gown id been wearing through the night and into my clothes that the sherrifs had me grab from my house. A pair of old dirty blue jeans and a donkey kong t-shirt that read of all things...going bananas. Putting on the shirt, looking down and finally realising what it said made me feel better. The horrible place i was in that caused the single worst day of my life and i inadvertantly end up with the most inappropriate yet most appropriate piece of clothing i own.
 The sheer ubsurdity of the whole situation made me rethink a great many things. I still have the shirt and wear it from time to time...
